# `BatchStack`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Progress of the batch stacking worker over stored frames.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, PrintBatchStackState @0x3a6900, StartBatchStack @0x3a6190 (64-bit build) |

Function producer: the batch stacking worker runs a named BatchStack function and its formatter adds the task members. Function-state family (F): state is always written; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms when the timer is started or the state is terminal; code and error at fail even when the stored code is 0 (cancel omits them); route optional. A null or nameless detail sends nothing, and non-working notifications can be suppressed while the function cache still changes, so a receiver cannot rely on seeing every transition. The formatter writes percent, frame_type, task_type, stacked_img and total_img; remaining_sec, input_thn, output_file and keep are conditional. The 32-bit build lacks startrail_video and keep. Progress depends on work; no timer. Recipients: all retained 4700 sockets. No reply-before-event order is established: the RPC reply that starts the worker and the worker's events can arrive in either order. No fixed cadence. The Event value is the worker's function name, which the worker definition sets to the literal BatchStack. APK consumer expectation, not a firmware field: estimated_sec.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver. The worker writes stacked output files.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"BatchStack"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Function-state name. idle is an initial/restored state and is not automatically sent; unknown internal codes fall back to idle. A formatter supporting a state does not mean every run visits it. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if non-empty stage string held | - | Only when a non-empty stage string is held. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if function producer: timer started (working) or terminal state | - | Elapsed milliseconds, independent of Timestamp. Working (or any state with a start and no end time, including complete) uses current monotonic minus start; other terminal states use end minus start. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail (function producer) | - | Function producer: present when state is fail, even if the stored code is 0. cancel omits it. Firmware 9.75, comet task: the worker stores 204 when the input or expanded list exceeds 200 frames (READ: the fail event carries code 204, error out of limit and max_frame_num 200), 9004 when too few candidates remain and 9005 or 9002 from the preflight; that the last three reach this member is unresolved. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail (function producer) | - | Message for code; present with code. Lookup failure gives fail to operate. [READ] |
| `max_frame_num` | integer | no | - | Firmware 9.75 (64-bit build), comet task: 200, sent with code 204 when the worker finds more than 200 input or expanded frames. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | if optional; absent is a legitimate branch | - | Function-tree ancestry (for example View, Stack) built at send time. May be absent; not an address. [READ] |
| `remaining_sec` | integer | if cached value >= 0 | - | Estimated remaining time; seconds INFERRED. [READ] |
| `percent` | number | no | - | Current percentage. [READ] |
| `frame_type` | string | no | - | Task frame type. [READ] |
| `task_type` | string | no | - | Task type. startrail_video is 64-bit only. One of: `deepsky`, `startrail_image`, `startrail_video`, `comet`. [READ] |
| `stacked_img` | integer | no | - | Processed input count. [READ] |
| `total_img` | integer | no | - | Total input count. [READ] |
| `input_thn` | string | if non-empty | - | Input thumbnail name. [READ] |
| `output_file` | object | if cached flag says output is available | - | Saved stacked result on the completing event, `{path, files}` with one file entry; the comet dual-stack task reports its own the same way. [READ] |
| `output_file.path` | string | yes | - | Output directory, relative to the storage root, without a trailing slash. [READ] |
| `output_file.files` | array<object> | yes | - | One object for the saved file; the builder pushes a single entry (no loop). Range: at least 1 item(s). [READ] |
| `output_file.files[].name` | string | yes | - | File path relative to the storage root. [READ] |
| `output_file.files[].date` | string | yes | - | Image date from the image metadata. [READ] |
| `output_file.files[].thn` | string | yes | - | Thumbnail name. [READ] |
| `output_file.files[].type` | integer | yes | - | Album file-type code [READ] |
| `keep` | boolean | if 64-bit build | - | Callback option. 64-bit build only. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, working - Progress (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"BatchStack","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","lapse_ms":30500,"remaining_sec":95,"percent":24.0,"frame_type":"light","task_type":"deepsky","stacked_img":12,"total_img":50,"keep":false}
```
